title: Men's Electrician – It's Probably the Breaker Hoodie

seo.title: Electrician Hoodie – It's Probably the Breaker
seo.description: A funny electrician hoodie for the guy everyone calls first: IT'S PROBABLY THE BREAKER. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

IT'S PROBABLY THE BREAKER. is the electrician hoodie for the guy every relative texts first, worn on the job site, at the family dinner and on the cold early shift.

IT'S PROBABLY runs across the top and THE BREAKER. fills the bottom, even wider, in heavy capitals. Between them an electrician in an orange hard hat and shirt flips a switch in an open breaker panel with a knowing squint, a small house with its windows glowing beside him.

Navy carries cream and orange lettering with a cream edge around the scene; Sand gets navy and orange lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a cold job site?
Yes. The It's Probably the Breaker hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer under a work jacket for cold early shifts, attic crawls and long days in unheated buildings.

How does the It's Probably the Breaker hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for an electrician?
It is a natural one. Every electrician has answered the breaker question at a family dinner, so it lands with the crew, the apprentices and relatives who keep calling. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the electrician sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the It's Probably the Breaker hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
